config.preview.title: MK4 — Preview
config.preview.debounceMs.description: Delay (in ms) before the preview updates after a keystroke. Increase this value on slower machines.
config.preview.enableScrollSync.descript: Synchronizes scrolling between the editor and the preview panel.
config.editor.enableCodeLens.description: Displays MK4 action buttons (CodeLens) at the top of Markdown files.
config.theme.title: MK4 — Theme
config.typst.defaultTheme.description: The default Typst theme to use for compilation.
config.typst.defaultTheme.enum.default: Clean and readable theme, without a separate cover page.
config.typst.defaultTheme.enum.modern: Modern theme with colored accents and a cover page.
config.typst.defaultTheme.enum.academic: Formal academic theme, inspired by LaTeX.
config.typst.customThemePath.description: Absolute path to a custom .typ file (overrides the default theme).
config.layout.title: MK4 — Layout
config.typst.lang.description: Document language code for the Typst output (`fr`, `en`, `de`…). Leave empty to automatically use the VS Code interface language.
config.typst.pageMargin.description: Page margins (e.g. `2.5cm`, `1in`, `20mm`). Applies to both horizontal and vertical margins.
config.typst.pageNumbering.description: Page numbering format displayed in the footer.
config.typography.title: MK4 — Typography
config.typst.fontFamily.description: Main document font (e.g. `Linux Libertine`, `New Computer Modern`, `Arial`). Leave empty to use the theme default.
config.typst.fontSize.description: Main font size (e.g. `11pt`, `12pt`, `10.5pt`). Leave empty to use the theme default.
config.typst.syntaxHighlighting.descript: Enables syntax highlighting in Typst code blocks.
